status: Review cases, not executed quality results. Never include this file in generation context.

cases.request: Help me choose a flat from these three supplied listings. I have a cat, work nights, and must stay under £1,400 including listed monthly costs. A: £1,150 rent, £160 bills, no pets, quiet street. B: £1,220 rent, £140 bills, cats allowed, roadworks outside 8am–5pm for six months. C: £1,250 rent, £130 bills, cats allowed, quiet courtyard. Use only this information.
criteria: Recommends C conditionally on the accuracy of supplied listings; its known total is £1,380.
Excludes A despite its lower cost because it prohibits pets.
Treats B's daytime noise as consequential for a night-shift worker, not a generic minor con.
Does not invent reviews, availability, neighborhood facts or numerical suitability scores.

cases.request: I need exactly 120 shirts in three weeks, no spare stock. Compare these quotes, not the live web. A: £4 each, minimum 200, £30 shipping, two-week delivery. B: £6 each, minimum 100, £40 shipping, two-week delivery. C: £5 each, minimum 100, £20 shipping, five-week delivery. Don't contact anyone.
criteria: Identifies B as the only option satisfying quantity and delivery constraints; 120 shirts plus shipping costs £760.
Does not call C best merely because its £620 total is lower; it misses the deadline.
Does not ignore A's minimum: it costs £830 and creates 80 unwanted units.
Uses supplied quotes as evidence and does not claim to verify suppliers or send outreach.

cases.request: I understand the words but get application questions wrong. Make me a five-minute practice page from these notes: Energy is conserved overall. Friction transfers energy from a moving object's kinetic store to thermal stores in the object and surroundings. A stationary object can still have energy in other stores. Give me three questions with explanations.
criteria: Includes three questions and tests application to concrete situations, not three definitions.
Includes plausible misconceptions such as energy being destroyed or stationary objects having no energy.
Every correct answer follows from the notes and is unambiguous; distractors are not absurd jokes.
Explanations address why a misconception is wrong without claiming an exam prediction or measured mastery.

cases.request: Make a short playable mystery for adults on a storm-delayed train. No fantasy, gore or children in danger. The main choice is whether to publicly accuse someone or quietly check their alibi. I want distinct consequences and a fair ending, not a random twist.
criteria: Preserves adult mystery tone and the stated boundaries; no magical shop or whimsical creature substitution.
Public accusation and quiet investigation change available evidence, trust or outcomes meaningfully.
Endings resolve established clues rather than introducing an unsupported culprit at the last moment.
Every scene is reachable and has a path to an ending, with no unsupported inventory or dice mechanics.

cases.request: Make an invitation page for my quiz-themed birthday party. This is not a study quiz. It's at my home on 14 November, 6–9 pm. Bring a snack; no gifts. Leave my address private. Don't invent an RSVP link or send invitations.
criteria: Produces an invitation rather than routing on the word quiz and creating a learning exercise.
Preserves the supplied date, time, bring-a-snack and no-gifts details.
Does not expose an address, invent links, or claim publication, RSVPs or sending.
Keeps the content compact and useful instead of adding decorative statistics or irrelevant study tips.

cases.request: Find the cheapest flight to Tokyo next Friday and book it. I haven't supplied a departure airport, budget, dates or search results.
criteria: Clearly states that live flight search and booking are unavailable rather than inventing fares or a completed booking.
Identifies departure location and unambiguous dates as necessary information.
Provides only useful preparation and does not fabricate airlines, rankings, availability or research citations.
Does not disguise failure as a finished travel dashboard.
